era: 1883-1950：奥匈帝国摩拉维亚特里施—维也纳大学—波恩大学—哈佛大学
era_en: 1883-1950: Trisch, Moravia (Austria-Hungary) — University of Vienna — University of Bonn — Harvard University
school: 奥地利-德国传统；演化经济学与创新理论；哈佛学派前驱
historical_significance: 二十世纪最重要的经济学家之一，演化经济学的奠基者。核心方法论：以『创造性破坏』重写资本主义的本质——发展不是均衡中的渐进积累，而是企业家以新组合（新产品/新方法/新市场/新供给/新组织）对循环流转的非连续打破；以创新簇驱动长中短三层周期嵌套解释经济波动；以暂时的垄断利润解释创新的动力结构；1942 年《资本主义、社会主义与民主》同时给出三大预言——资本主义将被自身成功所困、社会主义在组织技术上可行、民主是精英竞争的程序——塑造了此后八十年关于资本主义命运的全部讨论；1954 年遗作《经济分析史》至今仍是该领域的体系性巅峰。
historical_significance_en: One of the most important economists of the twentieth century and the founder of evolutionary economics. Core methodology: he rewrote the essence of capitalism as 'creative destruction'—development is not gradual accumulation in equilibrium but the discontinuous break of the circular flow by entrepreneurs carrying out new combinations (new products / methods / markets / supplies / organizations); he explained economic fluctuation through innovation clusters driving nested long, medium, and short cycles; and he explained the dynamics of innovation through temporary monopoly profit. His 1942 Capitalism, Socialism and Democracy issued three great prophecies at once—capitalism will be imperiled by its own success, socialism is organizationally feasible, and democracy is a procedure of elite competition—shaping eighty years of debate on the fate of capitalism. His posthumous History of Economic Analysis (1954) remains the monumental synthesis of the field.
unique_thinking: 最彻底的『演化视角』坚持者。核心方法论：一切经济与社会现象都要在其随时间被创造和摧毁的过程中理解——静态均衡分析给不出资本主义的真相；把创新定义为生产要素的新组合而非新发明，把企业家定义为实现组合的人而非天生的英雄，把利润定义为组合成功的暂时奖金而非剥削的常态；对制度变迁坚持双重记账——经济效率的账与合法性认知的账并存，第二本账的赤字决定第一本账还能记多久；对思想本身坚持『社会想象』立场——分析始于前分析视野，每个时代只能看见它想象得到的东西。他把经济学、社会学、政治学与史学织成互相引用的多面体，是二十世纪罕见的体系型思想家。
unique_thinking_en: The most thorough adherent of the 'evolutionary view.' Core methodology: every economic and social phenomenon must be understood in its process of being created and destroyed over time—static equilibrium analysis cannot yield the truth about capitalism; innovation is defined as new combination of factors rather than new invention, the entrepreneur as the one who carries out the combination rather than a born hero, and profit as the temporary prize of combinational success rather than the normal form of exploitation. For institutional change he kept double books—the ledger of economic efficiency and the ledger of legitimacy, the second ledger's deficit deciding how long the first can keep recording. For ideas themselves he held the 'pre-analytic vision' position: analysis begins in vision, and each age sees only what it can imagine. Weaving economics, sociology, political science, and history into a cross-cited polyhedron, he was one of the century's rare system-builders.
civilization_en: Western civilization (Europe and the United States)
key_works: 《经济发展理论》(The Theory of Economic Development, 1911)
《资本主义、社会主义与民主》(Capitalism, Socialism and Democracy, 1942)
《帝国主义社会学》与《社会阶级》两篇社会学论文 (1919/1927)

modes.domain_zh: 把经济变革理解为新组合从内部不断摧毁旧结构的演化过程，并据此诊断产业与组织的存续
modes.domain_en: Reading economic change as an evolutionary process in which new combinations incessantly destroy old structures from within, and diagnosing the survival of industries and firms accordingly
modes.definition_zh: 熊彼特对经济学的根本改写是：资本主义的本质不是均衡，而是演化——『创造性破坏』是资本主义的本质事实，推动它的不是价格竞争，而是新产品、新技术、新供给来源、新组织形式的竞争。1942 年《资本主义、社会主义与民主》中的经典表述是：掌握旧有供给源头的垄断者并非高枕无忧，真正的威胁来自新组合——铁路没有来自更多马车，而是让马车过时。诊断方法有三步：其一，识别当前利润的真实来源——是既有资产在受保护市场中的租金，还是对下一次组合创新的独占；其二，绘制破坏路径——问『什么会让现有核心资产一夜过时』，答案不是同业对手而是外部的替代组合；其三，评估组织的学习与退出能力——创造性破坏对经济整体是增长，对个体企业是淘汰，组织的存续取决于能否在旧业务被摧毁之前建成新业务。这一方法的深意是：把『竞争程度』的度量从静态的市场份额转向动态的进入与替代，政策与管理判断因此彻底改观——最危险的时刻恰恰是利润最丰厚、护城河看似最牢固的时刻。
modes.definition_en: Schumpeter's fundamental rewrite of economics was this: the essence of capitalism is not equilibrium but evolution—'creative destruction' is the essential fact about capitalism, driven not by price competition but by competition from the new commodity, the new technology, the new source of supply, the new type of organization. The classic statement of 1942 in Capitalism, Socialism and Democracy: the monopolist who commands the existing sources of supply is never secure; the real threat comes from the new combination—the railroad did not arise from more stagecoaches, it made them obsolete. The diagnostic has three steps. First, identify the true source of current profit—is it rent on existing assets in a protected market, or exclusivity over the next combinational innovation? Second, map the destruction path—ask what would make the existing core assets obsolete overnight; the answer is not the industry rival but an external substitute combination. Third, assess the organization's capacity to learn and to exit: creative destruction is growth for the economy as a whole and elimination for the individual firm, and survival depends on building the new business before the old one is destroyed. The deeper point: measure 'degree of competition' not by static market share but by dynamic entry and substitution—and policy and managerial judgment change completely. The most dangerous moment is precisely when profits are fattest and the moat looks strongest.
modes.source_chapter: 《资本主义、社会主义与民主》第七-八章 (Capitalism, Socialism and Democracy, 1942)；《经济发展理论》(The Theory of Economic Development, 1911)
modes.key_quote_zh: 资本主义的现实不是『王子与公主幸福地生活在一起』的均衡童话，而是一台不断从内部变革经济结构的机器——摧毁旧的，创造新的。
modes.key_quote_en: The reality of capitalism is not the fairy tale of 'and they all lived happily ever after' equilibrium, but a machine that incessantly revolutionizes the economic structure from within—destroying the old, creating the new.
process_zh: 识别利润的真实来源：区分来自受保护资产与既有渠道的租金，与来自对下一轮组合创新的暂时独占
绘制破坏路径：系统追问『什么外部新组合会让现有核心资产一夜过时』，明确替代来自行业外而非同业
评估新旧交替能力：检查组织能否在旧业务衰退前建成新业务——学习速度、退出机制与资本再配置通道
重校竞争度量：用进入率、替代事件与创新强度取代市场份额与价格离散，作为产业活力的判据
process_en: Identify the true source of profit: separate rent on protected assets and established channels from temporary exclusivity over the next round of combinational innovation
Map the destruction path: systematically ask which external new combination would make existing core assets obsolete overnight, recognizing that substitution comes from outside the industry
Assess old-to-new transition capacity: check whether the organization can build the new business before the old declines—learning speed, exit mechanisms, and channels for capital reallocation
Re-calibrate the measure of competition: use entry rates, substitution events, and innovation intensity instead of market share and price dispersion as indicators of industrial vitality
representative_cases_zh: 铁路对马车的替代：1942 年的原始案例——铁路公司的威胁不是另一家铁路公司，而是使『铁路』这一组合本身过时的下一轮交通创新
汽车业摧毁马车经济：不是让马车更好，而是让铁匠铺、马具行、马车厂整条产业链在一代人之内失去存在理由
英特尔对存储器的退出（1985）：管理层承认 DRAM 已是『旧组合』，把产能转向微处理器——在破坏完成前主动自弃其业
反例警示：创造性破坏不是为毁灭而毁灭——熊彼特强调破坏受『经济上是否更优』检验，金融骗局、纯补贴驱动的替代同样是破坏但非创造；判据是新组合的净生产率而非颠覆声势
representative_cases_en: Railroads versus stagecoaches: the original 1942 case—the threat to a railroad company is not another railroad but the next transport innovation that makes 'railroad' as a combination itself obsolete
The automobile destroying the horse-drawn economy: not by making carriages better but by stripping blacksmiths, harness makers, and carriage factories of their reason to exist within a generation
Intel's exit from memory (1985): management conceded DRAM had become an 'old combination' and shifted capacity to microprocessors—abandoning its own business before destruction completed it

Cautionary case: creative destruction is not destruction for its own sake—Schumpeter stressed destruction passes the test of economic superiority; financial scams and subsidy-driven substitution are destruction without creation; the criterion is net productivity of the new combination, not the drama of disruption
modern_applications_zh: 企业战略：把『二十年护城河』叙事换成『破坏路径清单』，每季度审计最可能让核心业务过时的外部新组合
产业政策：扶持对象从『在位大企业』转向『新组合进入者』，因为长期就业与增长来自替代而非保护
个人职业规划：与其在萎缩赛道上争夺存量，不如识别自己技能可迁移的新组合，主动完成自我替代
投资分析：对利润率极高且无对手的标的，先问破坏路径而非加仓——超额利润恰是新组合的靶标
modern_applications_en: Corporate strategy: replace the 'twenty-year moat' narrative with a destruction-path inventory; audit each quarter which external new combination is most likely to make the core business obsolete
Industrial policy: direct support to new-combination entrants rather than incumbent giants, because long-run employment and growth come from substitution, not protection
Career planning: rather than fighting for a shrinking stock in a declining track, identify the new combinations your skills can migrate to and complete self-substitution proactively
Investment analysis: for targets with very high margins and no rivals, ask for the destruction path before adding to the position—supranormal profit is precisely the target of new combinations

modes.domain_zh: 把创新定义为生产要素的重新组合，并按五种组合类型系统生成与评估创新机会
modes.domain_en: Defining innovation as the recombination of factors of production, and systematically generating and evaluating innovation opportunities along five types of new combination
modes.definition_zh: 熊彼特 1911 年《经济发展理论》的核心贡献，是把『创新』从模糊的灵感话语改造成可操作的定义：创新 = 实现新组合。经济在『循环流转』中只是按既有方式年复一年运转，发展则来自企业家把生产要素从旧用途中抽出、按新方式重新组合。新组合有五种类型：新产品、新生产方法、新市场、新供给来源、新产业组织。方法上有三步：其一，把问题还原为组合问题——你要的不是『一个新点子』，而是对既有要素（技术、渠道、原料、组织）的一次重新排列；其二，按五类清单系统扫描——逐类检查现有要素是否存在未被实现的重新排列，创新机会常在类别交界处（新技术 x 旧渠道）；其三，区分发明与创新的落地条件——新组合的实现要克服三重障碍：识别机会的洞察力、从旧用途抽出要素的融资（信贷在熊彼特体系中正是为此而生）、对抗惯性与既得利益的执行。这一方法的深意是：企业家精神不是天赋人格，而是一种可分析、可训练的组合操作——发现『要素都在场，只欠重组』的态势，并承担重组的组织责任。
modes.definition_en: The core contribution of Schumpeter's 1911 Theory of Economic Development was to transform 'innovation' from vague talk of inspiration into an operational definition: innovation = carrying out a new combination. In the 'circular flow' the economy merely repeats itself year after year; development comes when the entrepreneur withdraws factors from their old uses and recombines them in new ways. New combinations come in five types: a new product, a new method of production, a new market, a new source of supply, a new industrial organization. The method has three steps. First, reduce the problem to a combination problem—what you need is not 'a new idea' but a re-arrangement of existing factors (technology, channels, materials, organization). Second, scan systematically by the five-type checklist—examine class by class whether an unrealized re-arrangement of existing factors exists; opportunities cluster at the boundaries of types (new technology x old channel). Third, separate invention from innovation by its conditions of realization: carrying out a new combination must overcome three obstacles—insight to see the opportunity, financing to withdraw factors from old uses (credit, in Schumpeter's system, exists precisely for this), and execution against inertia and vested interests. The deeper point: entrepreneurship is not a gift of personality but a combinational operation that can be analyzed and trained—seeing the configuration where 'all the factors are present and only recombination is wanting' and bearing the organizational responsibility for it.
modes.source_chapter: 《经济发展理论》第二章 (The Theory of Economic Development, 1911)；《资本主义、社会主义与民主》第二篇 (1942)
modes.key_quote_zh: 创新不是发明新事物，而是把既有要素重新组合——经济史的进步是组合的历史，不是元素的历史。
modes.key_quote_en: Innovation is not inventing new things but recombining existing ones—the progress of economic history is a history of combinations, not of elements.
process_zh: 盘点既有要素清单：列出手头的生产要素、技术、渠道、关系与组织能力，不问『缺什么』先问『有什么』
按五类组合扫描：新产品/新方法/新市场/新供给/新组织，逐类检查是否存在未被实现的重新排列，重点扫描类别交界
识别实现障碍：对每个候选组合评估三重障碍——机会洞察、要素抽出的融资通道、对抗惯性的执行路径
承担组织责任：选定组合后以信贷与组织手段实际完成要素的抽取与重排，把组合从构想变为经济事实
process_en: Inventory existing factors: list the factors of production, technologies, channels, relationships, and organizational capabilities at hand—ask 'what do we have' before 'what are we missing'
Scan by the five combination types: new product / new method / new market / new supply / new organization, checking class by class for unrealized re-arrangements, focusing on intersections of types
Identify obstacles to realization: for each candidate combination assess the triple barrier—insight into the opportunity, financing channels for withdrawing factors, execution paths against inertia

Bear organizational responsibility: after choosing a combination, actually complete the withdrawal and re-arrangement of factors through credit and organization, turning the combination from conception into economic fact
representative_cases_zh: 施乐 PARC 与苹果：图形界面、鼠标、以太网全部已在场，乔布斯的新组合是把它们重排成可售产品——发明在研究所，创新在组合
丰田生产方式：机床、统计质量控制、流水线都是既有要素，大野耐一的新组合是『准时制 x 自働化』这一生产组织重排
小额信贷：尤努斯把既有要素（银行信贷原理 x 穷人的劳动与声誉）重排为团体联保贷款，开辟新市场——要素无一新造
反例警示：新组合不等于任意拼凑——组合必须通过经济检验（成本、需求、可行性），『为组合而组合』的伪创新（无需求的功能堆砌）在熊彼特定义下不是创新，只是失败的实验
representative_cases_en: Xerox PARC and Apple: graphical interface, mouse, and Ethernet were all already present; Jobs's new combination re-arranged them into a sellable product—invention in the lab, innovation in the combination

The Toyota Production System: machine tools, statistical quality control, and the assembly line were all existing factors; Ohno's new combination was the organizational re-arrangement 'just-in-time x jidoka'
Microcredit: Yunus recombined existing factors (banking credit principles x the labor and reputation of the poor) into group-lending, opening a new market—not a single element newly created

Cautionary case: new combination does not mean arbitrary assemblage—combinations must pass economic tests (cost, demand, feasibility); 'combination for combination's sake' pseudo-innovation (feature piles without demand) is not innovation in Schumpeter's sense, only a failed experiment
modern_applications_zh: 产品创新会议：用五类组合清单替代头脑风暴，逐类盘问现有要素的未实现排列，把『求新点子』改为『求新排列』
并购与投资筛选：优先评估标的与自有要素的组合界面（新技术 x 旧渠道、旧产品 x 新市场），而非标的独立价值
个人技能组合：职业跃迁常来自技能重排（本行技能 x 新行业场景），主动绘制自己的要素清单并扫描组合空位
组织创新预算：区分发明预算（研究）与创新预算（组合落地与融资），防止把研发开支误当作创新产出
modern_applications_en: Product innovation meetings: replace brainstorming with the five-type combination checklist, interrogating class by class what re-arrangements of existing factors are unrealized—seek new arrangements, not new ideas
M&A and investment screening: prioritize the combination interface between the target and your own factors (new technology x old channel, old product x new market) over the target's standalone value
Personal skill combinations: career leaps often come from skill recombination (core skills x new industry contexts); map your own factor inventory and scan for combination gaps
Organizational innovation budgets: separate invention budgets (research) from innovation budgets (combination realization and financing), so R&D spending is not mistaken for innovation output

modes.name_zh: 循环流转与发展突破法
modes.domain_zh: 区分经济的自我重复状态与打破重复的发展状态，识别突破发生的条件与阻力
modes.domain_en: Distinguishing the economy's self-repeating state from the developmental state that breaks repetition, and identifying the conditions and frictions under which breakthroughs occur
modes.definition_zh: 熊彼特理论大厦的地基是一组根本区分：『循环流转』（circular flow）是经济按既有轨道自我重复的状态——每个主体按经验与惯例行动，利润趋于零，变化只是适应性的；『发展』（development）则是对循环流转的打破——由企业家实现新组合所引致的非连续变迁。这一区分给出一个可操作的诊断方法：其一，判定对象经济（企业、行业、国家）处于流转态还是发展态——看其变化是适应性微调（更多同样的东西）还是组合性重构（不同性质的东西）；其二，识别突破的三大阻力—— inertia（做惯了的事无须理由，新事务须举证）、既得利益（旧组合的持有者会抵制要素被抽出）、不确定性（新组合无历史数据可循）；其三，确认突破的杠杆条件——企业家的意志与 vision、信贷对要素再配置的资助、以及一个允许新组合与旧组合并存的制度空间。这一方法的深意是：增长不是匀速的积累，而是『静水——破局——新轨道——再静水』的非连续序列；管理者与政策者最该问的不是『如何跑得更快』，而是『我们是否已在旧轨道上空转』。
modes.definition_en: The foundation of Schumpeter's theoretical edifice is a pair of fundamental distinctions: the 'circular flow' is the state in which the economy repeats itself along existing tracks—every agent acts by experience and routine, profit tends to zero, and change is merely adaptive; 'development' breaks the circular flow—discontinuous change induced by entrepreneurs carrying out new combinations. The distinction yields an operational diagnostic. First, determine whether the economy in question (firm, industry, nation) is in a flow state or a development state—whether its changes are adaptive fine-tuning (more of the same) or combinational reconstruction (something of a different kind). Second, identify the three great frictions of breakthrough: inertia (what has always been done needs no justification, the new must supply one), vested interests (holders of old combinations resist the withdrawal of factors), and uncertainty (the new combination has no historical data to consult). Third, confirm the leverage conditions of breakthrough—the entrepreneur's will and vision, credit to finance factor re-allocation, and an institutional space allowing new combinations to coexist with old. The deeper point: growth is not steady accumulation but a discontinuous sequence of 'still water—breakthrough—new track—still water again'; the question managers and policymakers should ask is not 'how to run faster' but 'are we already idling on the old track'.
modes.source_chapter: 《经济发展理论》第一、二章 (The Theory of Economic Development, 1911)；《经济周期》第一卷 (Business Cycles, 1939)
modes.key_quote_zh: 发展是对循环流转的打破——没有非连续，就没有真正的新事物；只有重复，和重复的加速。
modes.key_quote_en: Development is the breaking of the circular flow—without discontinuity there is nothing truly new, only repetition, and acceleration of repetition.
process_zh: 判定状态：检查变化是适应性的（同质扩展、价格与产量微调）还是组合性的（要素性质与组织方式改变）
清点三大阻力：对每个候选突破列出 inertia 的举证负担、受威胁的既得利益方、以及不可用历史数据消解的不确定性
检验杠杆条件：确认是否存在愿意承担组织责任的行动者、可动员的信贷支持、以及容忍新组合并存的制度空间
设计突破序列：把发展从一次性跃迁改为可重复的节奏——新轨道稳定后重新寻找下一个组合，防组织退回流转态
process_en: Diagnose the state: check whether change is adaptive (homogeneous expansion, fine-tuning of prices and quantities) or combinational (changes in the nature of factors and modes of organization)
Inventory the three frictions: for each candidate breakthrough list inertia's burden of proof, the vested interests threatened, and the uncertainty that no historical data can dissolve

Test the leverage conditions: confirm the presence of an actor willing to bear organizational responsibility, credit that can be mobilized, and institutional space tolerating the coexistence of new and old combinations

Design the breakthrough sequence: turn development from a one-off leap into a repeatable rhythm—once the new track stabilizes, hunt for the next combination to keep the organization from sliding back into circular flow
representative_cases_zh: 1911 年的原始对照：小镇经济年复一年按同样比例生产与消费（循环流转），直到一位企业家把蒸汽机引入织布业——利润在突破中诞生，又在模仿者涌入后蒸发回零
福特 T 型车到通用汽车：福特把汽车拉入大众循环流转（单一车型规模化）后，斯隆以年度车型与分期付款的新组合再度打破流转——同一行业两次发展
日本 1950-70 年代的连续突破：通产信贷配给与主银行制持续资助新组合（钢铁—造船—电子），使整个经济反复跳出流转态而非单点突破
反例警示：非连续不等于天天革命——熊彼特明确周期有长短嵌套，发展需要消化期；把『持续颠覆』当作常态的组织会摧毁自身积累，突破节奏须与吸收能力匹配
representative_cases_en: The original 1911 contrast: a town economy producing and consuming in the same proportions year after year (circular flow), until one entrepreneur introduces the steam engine into weaving—profit is born in the breakthrough and evaporates back to zero as imitators flood in

Ford's Model T to General Motors: after Ford drew automobiles into mass circular flow (one model, mass scale), Sloan broke the flow again with the new combinations of annual models and installment credit—two developments in one industry

Japan's continuous breakthroughs of 1950-70: MITI credit rationing and the main-bank system kept financing new combinations (steel—shipbuilding—electronics), letting the whole economy leap the flow repeatedly rather than breakthrough at a single point

Cautionary case: discontinuity does not mean daily revolution—Schumpeter explicitly nested cycles of varying length, and development needs digestion periods; an organization treating 'perpetual disruption' as normal destroys its own accumulation; the rhythm of breakthrough must match absorptive capacity
modern_applications_zh: 企业年度审计：增加一项『流转态检测』——过去三年核心流程与产品组合是否发生过组合性变化，连续为否则亮红灯
政策设计：识别区域经济中的流转态产业（低利润、无进入），把政策资源从补贴存量转向资助新组合的信贷与制度空间
个人成长节奏：把『努力学习』细分为流转型学习（现有技能强化）与发展型学习（能力组合重构），保证后者有固定配额
投资周期判断：用『突破-吸收』节奏而非线性外推预测行业——突破期给成长估值，吸收期给现金流估值
modern_applications_en: Annual corporate audit: add a 'circular-flow test'—did core processes and product combinations undergo combinational change in the past three years; a run of noes is a red flag

Policy design: identify circular-flow industries in the regional economy (low profit, no entry) and shift policy resources from subsidizing stock to financing credit and institutional space for new combinations

Personal growth rhythm: divide 'learning' into flow-type learning (reinforcing existing skills) and development-type learning (restructuring capability combinations), with a fixed quota for the latter
Investment cycle judgment: forecast industries by breakthrough-absorption rhythm rather than linear extrapolation—growth valuations in breakthrough phases, cash-flow valuations in absorption phases

modes.domain_zh: 把垄断利润重新理解为对创新的暂时报酬，并据此重新设计反垄断与创新政策的天平
modes.domain_en: Re-reading monopoly profit as temporary reward for innovation, and re-balancing antitrust and innovation policy accordingly
modes.definition_zh: 熊彼特对产业组织理论最具争议的重构是：垄断与创新不是对立关系，而是创新过程的内在环节。实现新组合的企业家天然获得一段排他期——没有暂时的垄断地位，创新者无法在模仿者涌入前收回创新投入；超额利润不是对消费者的剥削，而是对组合成功的『奖金』，且这个奖金在竞争中必然被侵蚀。方法上有三步：其一，区分两类垄断——来自规模、专利与暂时的组合优势的『演化型垄断』，与来自行政保护的『租金型垄断』，前者是创新的影子，后者是纯粹的再分配；其二，用动态标准取代静态标准——评估一个高份额企业不问『它是否排除了竞争』，而问『它的地位是否可被下一个新组合摧毁』：可摧毁则竞争仍然存在，只是换了战场；其三，设计暂租的耗散通道——确保专利期、可进入性与模仿扩散让暂租自动过期，而非永久化。这一方法的深意是：反垄断的靶心应从『大』转向『受保护的静滞』——真正的公共利益指标不是价格与份额，而是下一轮新组合是否仍被允许发生。大企业研发实验室（贝尔实验室、杜邦）正是熊彼特晚期判断的注脚：垄断租养得起大规模创新。
modes.definition_en: Schumpeter's most contested reconstruction of industrial organization: monopoly and innovation are not opposites but internal moments of the innovative process. The entrepreneur who carries out a new combination naturally earns a period of exclusivity—without a temporary monopoly position, the innovator cannot recoup the investment before imitators flood in; supranormal profit is not exploitation of consumers but a 'prize' for combinational success, and competition necessarily erodes it. The method has three steps. First, distinguish two kinds of monopoly—evolutionary monopoly from scale, patents, and temporary combinational advantage, and rent-monopoly from administrative protection: the former is the shadow of innovation, the latter pure redistribution. Second, replace static criteria with dynamic ones: to assess a high-share firm, ask not 'does it exclude competition' but 'is its position destroyable by the next new combination'—if destroyable, competition persists, only on a different battlefield. Third, design dissipation channels for the temporary rent: ensure that patent terms, entry conditions, and imitative diffusion let the rent expire automatically rather than ossify. The deeper point: the target of antitrust should shift from 'bigness' to 'protected stagnation'—the true public-interest metric is not price and share but whether the next new combination is still allowed to happen. The corporate R&D laboratories of Bell and DuPont are footnotes to Schumpeter's later judgment: monopoly rents can afford large-scale innovation.
modes.source_chapter: 《资本主义、社会主义与民主》第八章 (Capitalism, Socialism and Democracy, 1942)；《经济发展理论》(1911)
modes.key_quote_zh: 不受威胁的垄断者无利润可守——静态的完美竞争里没有创新的位置，暂时的垄断是创新的助产士。
modes.key_quote_en: A monopolist under no threat has no profit to defend—static perfect competition has no room for innovation; temporary monopoly is the midwife of innovation.
process_zh: 归因垄断来源：解剖高份额企业的地位来自组合优势与专利（演化型）还是行政准入与排他协议（租金型）
施加动态检验：问『什么新组合能摧毁它的地位』，若能举出可信路径则竞争仍在；若答案是『不可能，因其地位受保护』则警报
审计租金耗散：检查专利/版权期限、许可政策、进入成本是否让暂租按设计过期，而非被法律与关系永久化
重排政策靶心：把监管火力从『大与份额』转向『静滞与保护』，对演化型垄断以创新强度考核，对租金型垄断拆保护
process_en: Attribute the source of monopoly: dissect whether a high-share firm's position derives from combinational advantage and patents (evolutionary) or administrative access and exclusivity agreements (rent-type)
Apply the dynamic test: ask which new combination could destroy its position—if a credible path can be named, competition persists; if the answer is 'none, its position is protected,' sound the alarm
Audit rent dissipation: check whether patent/copyright terms, licensing policy, and entry costs let temporary rents expire as designed rather than ossify through law and connections

Re-aim the policy target: shift regulatory fire from 'bigness and share' to 'stagnation and protection'; appraise evolutionary monopoly by innovation intensity and dismantle protection for rent-type monopoly
representative_cases_zh: 贝尔实验室的垄断租转化：AT&T 的受规管垄断利润供养了晶体管、信息论、卫星通信——熊彼特『大企业养研发』命题的最著名实例
专利药与仿制药交替：药企凭专利暂租回收研发成本，专利悬崖后仿制药涌入使租自动耗散——设计良好的暂租生命周期
施乐对复印机的组合垄断：靠纸带耗材与专利组合维持暂租，但激光打印机新组合最终摧毁之——动态检验成立的案例
反例警示：暂租逻辑不豁免一切垄断——熊彼特 1942 年的乐观（垄断者终会被推翻）在行政性护城河（牌照、补贴、数据封锁）面前失效；凡垄断地位由法律而非组合维持者，动态检验即失败
representative_cases_en: Bell Labs converting monopoly rent: AT&T's regulated monopoly profits funded the transistor, information theory, and satellite communication—the most famous instance of Schumpeter's 'big firms afford R&D' thesis
Branded and generic drug alternation: pharma recovers R&D costs through patent rents; after the patent cliff generics flood in and the rent dissipates—a well-designed temporary-rent life cycle
Xerox's combinational monopoly on copiers: rents sustained by patent bundles and consumables, finally destroyed by the new combination of laser printing—a case where the dynamic test worked

Cautionary case: the temporary-rent logic does not exempt all monopoly—Schumpeter's 1942 optimism (the monopolist will be overthrown in the end) fails before administrative moats (licenses, subsidies, data lockdowns); wherever monopoly rests on law rather than combination, the dynamic test fails
modern_applications_zh: 反垄断改革讨论：以『地位可摧毁性』替代份额阈值作为核心指标，对平台经济区分网络效应型与排他协议型垄断
企业定价与专利策略：把暂租当作有期限的资产经营——定价、许可与代际产品节奏按『租耗散前完成下一组合』倒排
公共研发评估：接受『项目失败率高』是暂租机制的正常成本，考核看组合产出而非单项目成功率
职业教育：向管理者解释『合法的暂时排他』与『寻租的永久保护』的界限，避免道德化反垄断叙事
modern_applications_en: Antitrust reform debate: replace share thresholds with 'destroyability of position' as the core metric, distinguishing network-effect monopoly from exclusivity-agreement monopoly in platform economics

Corporate pricing and patent strategy: run the temporary rent as a dated asset—price, licensing, and generational product cadence back-planned from 'next combination complete before the rent dissipates'
Public R&D appraisal: accept high project failure rates as the normal cost of the rent mechanism; judge by combinational output, not per-project success rates
Professional education: teach managers the boundary between lawful temporary exclusivity and rent-seeking permanent protection, de-moralizing antitrust narratives

modes.domain_zh: 用长中短三层周期嵌套的框架为经济波动定位，区分趋势、周期与噪音
modes.domain_en: Locating economic fluctuations within a framework of nested long, medium, and short cycles, separating trend, cycle, and noise
modes.definition_zh: 《经济周期》（1939）是熊彼特最庞大的工程：把资本主义经济运动刻画为三个周期的叠加——康德拉季耶夫长波（约半个世纪，由技术革命簇驱动）、尤格拉中周期（约十年，由设备与投资驱动）、基钦短周期（约四十个月，由库存驱动）。三层嵌套意味着任意时点的经济状态是三个波的相位合成：长波繁荣中的短波衰退是买入信号，长波衰退中的短波繁荣是逃命窗口。方法上有三步：其一，定位长波相位——判断当前处于哪一轮技术革命簇的导入期、狂热期、成熟期还是衰退期（创新簇的出现与扩散是长波的原动力）；其二，分离中周期与短周期——用设备投资序列与库存序列把总波动分解为两个较快分量，避免把库存噪音误读为趋势转折；其三，相位合成决策——只在三层信号共振时下重注：长波方向给战略、中波给战术、短波给时机。这一方法的深意是：任何单一时序数据都是三层波的混叠，把周期当趋势或把噪音当周期的错误，都源于缺少嵌套分解框架。熊彼特明知该框架难以精确检验，仍坚持其价值在于给混乱波动一个可讨论的结构。
modes.definition_en: Business Cycles (1939) was Schumpeter's most colossal engineering work: portraying capitalist economic motion as the superposition of three cycles—the Kondratieff long wave (roughly half a century, driven by clusters of technological revolution), the Juglar medium cycle (about a decade, driven by equipment and investment), and the Kitchin short cycle (about forty months, driven by inventories). Nesting means the state of the economy at any moment is the phase-synthesis of three waves: a short-wave downturn inside a long-wave boom is a buying signal; a short-wave boom inside a long-wave downturn is an escape window. The method has three steps. First, locate the long-wave phase: judge where we stand in the current cluster of technological revolution—installation, frenzy, maturity, or decline (the appearance and diffusion of innovation clusters is the long wave's prime mover). Second, separate medium and short cycles: decompose total fluctuation into its two faster components using equipment-investment and inventory series, so inventory noise is not misread as trend inflection. Third, phase-synthesize decisions: place large bets only when all three layers resonate—long wave sets strategy, medium wave tactics, short wave timing. The deeper point: any single time series is an aliasing of three waves, and the errors of mistaking cycle for trend or noise for cycle both stem from lacking a nesting framework. Schumpeter knew the framework resisted precise testing, yet insisted its value lay in giving chaotic fluctuation a discussable structure.
modes.source_chapter: 《经济周期》两卷本 (Business Cycles, 1939)；康德拉季耶夫长波研究的熊彼特化综合
modes.key_quote_zh: 每一次繁荣都同时是三个周期的一次相位——读错层次的人，会在长波顶点为短波反弹欢呼。
modes.key_quote_en: Every boom is simultaneously one phase of three cycles—those who misread the layer cheer a short-wave rebound at the peak of the long wave.
process_zh: 定位长波相位：识别当前技术革命簇（及其主导产业）处于导入、扩散狂热还是成熟衰退，用基础设施与渗透率作判据
分解中短分量：以设备投资序列提取尤格拉分量、以库存序列提取基钦分量，检查总波动中有多少比例可归因于各层
检查相位共振：列出三层各自的方向与相位差，确认是否存在共振（同向叠加）或对冲（长短互反）
按层分配决策：战略对长波、战术对中波、时机对短波；避免用短波证据改写长波判断
process_en: Locate the long-wave phase: identify where the current technological-revolution cluster and its leading industries stand—installation, diffusion frenzy, or maturity/decline—judging by infrastructure buildout and penetration rates

Decompose medium and short components: extract the Juglar component from equipment-investment series and the Kitchin component from inventory series, checking what share of total fluctuation each layer explains
Check phase resonance: list each layer's direction and phase lag, confirming whether resonance (same-direction superposition) or hedging (long and short opposed) prevails
Assign decisions by layer: strategy to the long wave, tactics to the medium wave, timing to the short wave; never rewrite long-wave judgment on short-wave evidence
representative_cases_zh: 熊彼特 1939 年的同步判断：他把 1930 年代大萧条解读为三个周期的谷底叠加——第三长波（钢铁/电气）衰退、尤格拉谷、基钦谷同时到位，解释了萧条为何异常深
铁路繁荣与 1873 危机：第一长波的狂热顶点与尤格拉衰退共振，历史检验了共振位即最大脆弱位
1990 年代信息长波导入：互联网簇（第三长波之后的第四长波）导入期叠加上行尤格拉——新技术簇定位的成功应用
反例警示：三周期框架曾因『参数不可检验』被主流放弃——熊彼特自己在《经济周期》序言承认历史与统计检验不足以确立周期严格性；使用该框架须声明其为组织性假说而非预测定理，拒绝伪精确
representative_cases_en: Schumpeter's 1939 synchronized reading: he interpreted the Great Depression as the superposed trough of three cycles—third long wave (steel/electricity) in decline, Juglar trough, and Kitchin trough arriving together, explaining the depression's abnormal depth
Railway boom and the crisis of 1873: the frenzy peak of the first long wave resonating with a Juglar downturn—history testing that resonance points are points of maximal fragility
The 1990s installation of the information long wave: the internet cluster's installation phase atop an upswing Juglar—a successful application of new-cluster positioning

Cautionary case: the three-cycle framework was abandoned by the mainstream for untestable parameters—Schumpeter himself conceded in the preface to Business Cycles that historical and statistical tests could not establish strict periodicity; users must declare it an organizing hypothesis, not a predictive theorem, and refuse pseudo-precision
modern_applications_zh: 投资组合构建：把资产按长波暴露（技术簇主题）、中波暴露（资本开支敏感）、短波暴露（库存敏感）分层配置
宏观研究框架：报告标配三层分解——先声明长波相位假设，再做中短归因，禁止直接从月度数据外推十年结论
企业产能决策：扩产对齐中波相位而非短期订单热度，避免在基钦高峰投资、在基钦谷底砍产能的经典错位
个人阅读经济新闻：给每条『转折』报道标注它可能属于哪一层周期，训练对混叠信号的免疫力
modern_applications_en: Portfolio construction: allocate assets in layers by long-wave exposure (technology-cluster themes), medium-wave exposure (capex sensitivity), and short-wave exposure (inventory sensitivity)

Macroeconomic research framework: a standard three-layer decomposition in reports—declare the long-wave phase assumption first, then attribute the medium and short, never extrapolating decade-scale conclusions from monthly data

Corporate capacity decisions: align expansion with the medium-wave phase rather than short-term order heat, avoiding the classic error of investing at a Kitchin peak and cutting capacity at a Kitchin trough
Reading economic news: tag every 'inflection' report with the cycle layer it may belong to, training immunity against aliased signals

modes.name_zh: 资本主义合法性审计法
modes.domain_zh: 诊断一个资本主义（或市场化）体系的成功是否正在侵蚀其自身的社会与政治合法性
modes.domain_en: Diagnosing whether a capitalist (or marketized) system's success is eroding its own social and political legitimacy
modes.definition_zh: 熊彼特 1942 年最惊人的预言不是『社会主义会来』，而是『资本主义会被自己的成功杀死』：大企业把创新变成例行公事，企业家职能萎缩；经理阶层取代所有者，资本家的护佑阶层消失；知识分子——一个随教育普及而膨胀、天然需要批判对象的群体——把资本主义的失败叙事制度化；官僚化让政治态度与私人情感脱离经济理性。由此他得出『创造性破坏的会计』被社会不接受的结果：增长在统计上成立，在人心上不成立。审计方法有四步：其一，审计企业家职能的位置——创新是由个人企业家承担，还是已彻底官僚化为流程，后者让体系的活力与人格脱钩；其二，审计护佑阶层的存亡——还有没有真实承担风险、其存在与体系存续利益一致的所有者阶层为体系辩护；其三，审计知识阶层与体系的关系——批判是修正性的（发现问题促其改进）还是清算性的（否认体系正当性本身）；其四，审计分配可见性——统计上的帕累托改进是否被感知为公平，账面增长是否转化为大众的获得感。这一方法的深意是：制度存续依赖两个账本——经济账与合法性账，第二个账本的赤字不会出现在任何财务报表上，却决定第一个账本还能记多久。
modes.definition_en: Schumpeter's most astonishing prophecy of 1942 was not 'socialism will come' but 'capitalism will be killed by its own success': big business turns innovation into routine and the entrepreneurial function withers; managers replace owners and the bourgeois stratum that shielded capitalism disappears; intellectuals—a group inflated by mass education and naturally in need of something to criticize—institutionalize the narrative of capitalism's failure; bureaucratization detaches political attitude from economic rationality. Hence the result that the 'accounting of creative destruction' is socially unacceptable: growth holds up statistically but not in hearts and minds. The audit has four steps. First, audit the locus of the entrepreneurial function: is innovation borne by individual entrepreneurs or fully bureaucratized into process—the latter decouples the system's vitality from persons. Second, audit the survival of the shielding stratum: is there still an owning class that genuinely bears risk, whose existence is aligned with the system's survival, to defend it? Third, audit the intelligentsia's relation to the system: is criticism corrective (finding problems so they can be fixed) or liquidationist (denying the legitimacy of the system itself)? Fourth, audit the visibility of distribution: whether statistically Pareto-improving growth is perceived as fair, whether ledger growth converts into the masses' sense of gain. The deeper point: institutional survival depends on two ledgers—the economic and the legitimacy ledger—and a deficit in the second appears on no financial statement, yet decides how long the first can keep recording.
modes.source_chapter: 《资本主义、社会主义与民主》第二篇『资本主义能存在下去吗』(Capitalism, Socialism and Democracy, 1942)
modes.key_quote_zh: 扼杀资本主义的不是它的失败，而是它的成功——一个总在改善大众生活的制度，恰恰得不到大众的感激。
modes.key_quote_en: What kills capitalism is not its failure but its success—a system that keeps improving mass life earns precisely no mass gratitude.
process_zh: 审计企业家职能：定位创新由谁承担（个人/部门/外包流程），评估企业家精神与组织权力是否已经脱钩
审计护佑阶层：识别是否存在利益与体系存续一致、且在公共领域发声的承担风险者群体
审计批判结构：把舆论中的体系批判分类为修正性/清算性，统计后者在主流话语中的占比与制度化程度（教育、媒体）
审计分配感知：用调查与叙事分析对照统计分配——增长是否被感知为公平，失败者是否有可讲述的上升通道故事
process_en: Audit the entrepreneurial function: locate who bears innovation (individuals / departments / outsourced process) and assess whether entrepreneurial spirit has decoupled from organizational power
Audit the shielding stratum: identify whether a risk-bearing group whose interests align with the system's survival still speaks in the public sphere
Audit the critical structure: classify criticism of the system as corrective or liquidationist, tallying the latter's share and institutionalization in mainstream discourse (education, media)
Audit the perception of distribution: contrast statistical allocation with surveys and narrative analysis—whether growth is perceived as fair and whether losers have a tellable upward-mobility story
representative_cases_zh: 1942 年的原始论证：美国大公司研发制度化后，『进步』从个人功绩变成品牌叙事——熊彼特预判所有权与经营分离会掏空体系的政治地基
战后福利共识的兴起：资本主义在 1950-70 年代交付了史上最好的大众生活水平，而同期对它的政治敌意持续上升——合法性与绩效脱钩的经典窗口
2008 危机后的批判转向：金融化让『创造性破坏的账单』由纳税人支付，修正性批判大规模滑向清算性批判——审计第三步的现实显影
反例警示：熊彼特预言已被部分证伪——企业家职能以风投、创业生态等新形式复兴，护佑阶层并未消失而是重组；审计须区分『旧形态死亡』与『职能本身消失』，警惕把形态更替误判为制度衰亡
representative_cases_en: The original 1942 argument: after American corporations institutionalized R&D, 'progress' changed from personal achievement to brand narrative—Schumpeter predicted the separation of ownership and control would hollow out the system's political foundations
The postwar welfare consensus: capitalism delivered history's best mass living standards in 1950-70 while political hostility to it kept rising—the classic window on legitimacy-performance decoupling

The post-2008 critical turn: financialization handed 'the bills of creative destruction' to taxpayers, and corrective criticism slid into liquidationism at scale—the third audit step made visible in reality

Cautionary case: Schumpeter's prophecy has been partly falsified—the entrepreneurial function revived in new forms (venture capital, startup ecosystems), and the shielding stratum reorganized rather than vanished; the audit must distinguish 'death of the old form' from 'disappearance of the function itself,' guarding against mistaking form-change for institutional demise
modern_applications_zh: 企业声誉管理：把『我们创造了什么岗位/税收/技术』的绩效叙事升级为『失败者与转型者的出路』的分配叙事
政策沟通设计：任何市场化改革方案须并行设计合法性账本——受损补偿、上升通道故事与批判的修正性引导
组织变革：大公司创新官僚化后，审计内部创业者是否还有创业收益归属，防止『企业家职能外包给了离职者』
投资尽调（社会稳定维度）：对高增长经济体增加合法性审计——分配感知与批判性质，识别增长数字掩盖的清算性叙事累积
modern_applications_en: Corporate reputation: upgrade the performance narrative ('jobs, taxes, technology we created') into a distribution narrative ('paths out for the losers and the transformed')
Policy communication: design the legitimacy ledger in parallel with any market-reform package—compensation for the harmed, upward-mobility stories, and steering criticism toward the corrective

Organizational change: after corporate innovation bureaucratizes, audit whether internal entrepreneurs still own their entrepreneurial returns, preventing 'the entrepreneurial function outsourced to those who quit'

Investment due diligence (social-stability lens): add a legitimacy audit for high-growth economies—perceived distribution and the nature of criticism, detecting accumulation of liquidationist narratives beneath the growth numbers

modes.domain_zh: 把民主重新定义为争夺决策权的竞争性程序，并用该定义诊断现实政体的健康度
modes.domain_en: Redefining democracy as a competitive procedure for the pursuit of decision power, and using that definition to diagnose the health of real regimes
modes.definition_zh: 熊彼特 1942 年给出的民主定义是二十世纪政治学的一次哥白尼翻转：民主不是『人民做主』的规范理想，而是一种方法——『达成政治决定的制度安排，其中个人通过竞争人民的选票获得决策权』。投票不是赋予人民统治权，而是产生政府的竞争机制，如同市场机制产生价格。方法上有三步：其一，把政体问题从『人民是否真的做主』改写为『 elites 是否真的可被替换』——民主的健康度不取决于人民统治的神话，而取决于领导权竞争的真实性（进入自由、失败者接受结果、任期限定）；其二，逐项检验竞争条件——政治市场的入场自由（候选人能否无碍竞争）、信息竞争（选民能否获得差异化信息而非单一宣传）、失败者的退出协议（败选方是否承认结果并在野等待）；其三，识别民主的病理——选民理性局限（对政治的注意力与知识天然稀薄）、利益集团的过滤、科层机器对竞争的中和。这一方法的深意是：对民主的批判应从『人民无知』的道德化抱怨，转向『竞争条件失守』的结构诊断——前者无解，后者可修。这一实证化定义深刻塑造了此后政治学的『民主的经济学』研究纲领。
modes.definition_en: Schumpeter's 1942 definition of democracy was a Copernican turn in twentieth-century political science: democracy is not the normative ideal of 'rule by the people' but a method—'that institutional arrangement for arriving at political decisions in which individuals acquire the power to decide by means of a competitive struggle for the people's vote.' The vote does not confer rule upon the people; it is the competitive mechanism that produces governments, as the market mechanism produces prices. The method has three steps. First, rewrite the question of a regime from 'do the people really rule' to 'can elites really be replaced'—the health of democracy depends not on the myth of popular rule but on the reality of competition for leadership (free entry, losers' acceptance, term limits). Second, test the conditions of competition item by item—free entry to the political market (can candidates compete unhindered), informational competition (can voters obtain differentiated information rather than unified propaganda), and the losers' exit protocol (does the defeated side concede and wait in opposition). Third, identify the pathologies of democracy—voters' bounded rationality (naturally thin attention and knowledge for politics), the filter of interest groups, and the neutralization of competition by bureaucratic machines. The deeper point: criticism of democracy should shift from moralized complaints about voter ignorance to structural diagnosis of failed competitive conditions—the former has no remedy, the latter can be repaired. This positivized definition shaped political science's 'economic theory of democracy' research program for decades after.
modes.source_chapter: 《资本主义、社会主义与民主》第三篇第二十一章 (Capitalism, Socialism and Democracy, 1942)
modes.key_quote_zh: 民主是精英争夺选票的竞争方法——它不保证人民做主，只保证做主的人可以被换掉。
modes.key_quote_en: Democracy is the competitive method by which elites struggle for votes—it guarantees not that the people rule, but that those who do can be replaced.
process_zh: 改写核心问题：放弃『人民是否真实统治』的形而上追问，改为『决策者是否可通过竞争程序被替换』
逐项检验竞争条件：入场自由、信息多元、失败者协议、任期限定——缺项即标记该政体民主赤字的具体来源
诊断竞争病理：评估利益集团过滤、注意力经济对政治信息的扭曲、科层化对领导人问责的中和
开结构处方：把改革精力投入竞争条件的修复（准入、透明、轮替规则）而非选民素养的道德劝勉
process_en: Rewrite the core question: abandon the metaphysical query 'do the people truly rule' for 'can decision-makers be replaced through competitive procedure'
Test competitive conditions item by item: free entry, plural information, the losers' protocol, term limits—each missing item marks a specific source of democratic deficit

Diagnose the pathologies of competition: assess interest-group filtering, the distortion of political information by the attention economy, and bureaucratization's neutralization of leader accountability
Prescribe structurally: invest reform energy in repairing competitive conditions (access, transparency, rotation rules) rather than moral exhortation of voter virtue
representative_cases_zh: 1942 年原始定义的对手方：熊彼特逐一反驳『古典民主学说』（共同幸福 x 人民意志），指出两者在多元社会里均无操作性——共同幸福因价值分歧不可定义，人民意志因可被制造而不可靠
唐斯《民主的经济理论》(1957)：把熊彼特的竞争定义形式化为『政党=追求选票的企业』模型——定义转化为研究纲领的实例
新兴民主政体的回退：竞争程序存在（有选举）但失败者协议缺失（败方不承认结果）——用四条件清单可精确定位其民主赤字不在投票环节而在退出环节
反例警示：最小定义不等于最低标准的满足——熊彼特明确该定义是描述性起点而非辩护终点；若用『至少有选举』豁免一切竞争条件缺陷，就把他的诊断工具降格为洗白工具
representative_cases_en: The counterpoint of the original 1942 definition: Schumpeter refuted the 'classical doctrine' (common good x popular will) point by point as inoperative in pluralist society—the common good is undefinable amid value disagreement, and the popular will unreliable because it can be manufactured
Downs, An Economic Theory of Democracy (1957): formalizing Schumpeter's competitive definition into 'parties as vote-maximizing firms'—an instance of the definition becoming a research program

Backsliding in new democracies: the competitive procedure exists (elections are held) but the losers' protocol is absent (defeated parties reject results)—the four-condition checklist precisely locates the deficit not in voting but in exit

Cautionary case: the minimal definition is not a license for minimal standards—Schumpeter was explicit that it is a descriptive starting point, not an apologetic endpoint; using 'there are elections' to exempt defects in competitive conditions degrades his diagnostic tool into a whitewashing tool
modern_applications_zh: 政体风险评估：用四条件清单（入场/信息/失败者/期限）替代二元『民主/不民主』标签，输出结构化的民主赤字档案
组织治理迁移：把『精英竞争』引入企业——高管更替通过可竞争程序而非暗箱，失败者获得体面退出与再起通道
投票与公投设计：承认选民注意力稀缺，把复杂议题的投票设计为信息竞争友好的形式（可比较的选项陈述）
政治传播审计：检测某信息环境是否满足『信息竞争』条件——多元来源、可核查、差异化批评是否可得
modern_applications_en: Regime risk assessment: replace binary democracy/autocracy labels with the four-condition checklist (entry/information/loser/term), producing structured democratic-deficit profiles

Transfer to organizational governance: introduce elite competition into firms—executive succession through contestable procedures rather than smoke-filled rooms, with dignified exit and return channels for losers
Ballot and referendum design: acknowledging voters' scarce attention, design complex votes in information-competition-friendly forms (comparable statements of options)
Political communication audit: test whether an information environment meets the 'informational competition' condition—plural sources, verifiability, and the availability of differentiated criticism

modes.domain_zh: 诊断创新从企业家职能退化为例行公事的临界点，并设计反官僚化的组织结构
modes.domain_en: Diagnosing the threshold at which innovation degenerates from entrepreneurial function into routine, and designing organizational structures against bureaucratization
modes.definition_zh: 熊彼特思想中有著名的『两个熊彼特』问题：1911 年的熊彼特把创新归于英雄式个人企业家，1942 年的熊彼特承认创新已在大企业研发实验室里『例行公事化』（bureaucratization of innovation）。这不是自我矛盾，而是他给出的演化诊断：创新职能随企业规模与制度化程度发生形态迁移，且每次迁移都有得有失。临界诊断方法有四步：其一，绘制创新职能地图——创意产生、评估、融资、执行各环节分别由谁承担，标记每环节的『人格化程度』（依赖特定个人）与『流程化程度』；其二，计算例行化的收益与代价——收益是规模、可重复与低风险，代价是突破性组合（偏离现有能力地图的）被流程过滤器系统性淘汰；其三，定位临界信号——创新通过率上升但平均影响下降、内部创意者离职创业、研发产出向渐进改进收敛；其四，设计双轨结构——用流程化轨道承接渐进创新，用庇护所轨道（独立预算、隔离考核、回传通道）保留企业家职能。这一方法的深意是：官僚化不是道德失败而是规模的正态后果，问题不是阻止它而是为不可流程化的那类创新保留飞地。
modes.definition_en: The famous 'two Schumpeters' problem runs through his thought: the Schumpeter of 1911 attributed innovation to heroic individual entrepreneurs, while the Schumpeter of 1942 conceded that innovation had been 'routinized' in the R&D laboratories of large corporations. This is not self-contradiction but the evolutionary diagnosis he offers: the entrepreneurial function migrates in form with firm scale and institutionalization, and every migration involves gains and losses. The threshold diagnostic has four steps. First, map the innovation function—who generates, evaluates, finances, and executes ideas, marking each stage's 'degree of personification' (dependence on particular individuals) versus 'degree of routinization'. Second, compute the gains and costs of routinization—gains are scale, repeatability, and low risk; the cost is that breakthrough combinations (those deviating from the existing capability map) are systematically filtered out. Third, locate threshold signals—innovation pass-rates rising while average impact falls, internal creatives leaving to found startups, R&D output converging on incremental improvement. Fourth, design a dual-track structure—a routinized track for incremental innovation and a refuge track (independent budget, insulated appraisal, feedback channels) preserving the entrepreneurial function. The deeper point: bureaucratization is not moral failure but the normal consequence of scale; the task is not to prevent it but to preserve enclaves for the innovations that cannot be routinized.
modes.source_chapter: 《资本主义、社会主义与民主》第七章 (1942)；《经济发展理论》第二版序言的『两个熊彼特』对照 (1911/1926)
modes.key_quote_zh: 当创新变成例行公事，企业家就变成了任何部门的经理——组织的胜利里埋着组织的僵化。
modes.key_quote_en: When innovation becomes routine, the entrepreneur becomes any departmental manager—organization's victory buries organization's rigidity within it.
process_zh: 绘制创新职能地图：逐环节标注承担者及其人格化/流程化程度，找出过度依赖单点或过度流程化的环节
量化例行化损益：统计流程过滤的通过率、平均影响与偏离度，识别『被系统性淘汰的组合类型』
监测临界信号：建立创新影响分布的追踪（若向渐进改进收敛且创意者流失率上升，即接近临界）
实施双轨庇护：为突破性组合设立独立预算、隔离考核与高层回传的飞地，并规定飞地与主流程的移植协议
process_en: Map the innovation function: stage by stage, mark who bears each part and its personification/routinization degree, locating stages over-dependent on single points or over-proceduralized
Quantify routinization's gains and losses: track the process filter's pass rate, average impact, and deviation, identifying 'which combination types are systematically eliminated'
Monitor threshold signals: track the distribution of innovation impact—convergence on incremental improvement with rising creative attrition signals the threshold

Implement dual-track refuge: establish enclaves for breakthrough combinations with independent budgets, insulated appraisal, and executive feedback, with transplantation protocols between enclave and mainline
representative_cases_zh: 杜邦与 AT&T 中央实验室：1942 年命题的历史实证——大企业研发制度化确实产出了尼龙与晶体管（例行化的胜利），但也孕育了内部创意出逃（施乐 PARC 成就了苹果，而非施乐自己）
施乐 PARC 悖论：例行化巨头的庇护所研究（PARC）产出图形界面、以太网、激光打印，却因移植协议缺失，突破被主业务过滤——临界法第四步缺失的经典案例
谷歌 20% 时间与 X 实验室：双轨结构的当代尝试——用制度化的『制度内企业家精神』对冲例行化，成败取决于飞地与主线的移植带宽
反例警示：反官僚化不是取消流程——无流程的『创新狂热』让组织在伪突破上耗散资源；例行化轨道与庇护轨道须保持配比，熊彼特的诊断是权衡问题而非立场问题
representative_cases_en: DuPont and AT&T central labs: the historical verification of the 1942 thesis—institutionalized big-firm R&D did deliver nylon and the transistor (routinization's victory), yet also incubated creative flight (Xerox PARC enriched Apple, not Xerox)

The Xerox PARC paradox: the refuge research of a routinized giant produced the GUI, Ethernet, and laser printing, but without transplantation protocols the breakthroughs were filtered by the mainline—the classic case of a missing fourth step

Google's 20% time and X lab: a contemporary attempt at dual-track structure—institutionalizing 'entrepreneurship inside the institution' to hedge routinization, its success hinging on transplantation bandwidth between enclave and mainline

Cautionary case: anti-bureaucratization is not abolishing process—process-free 'innovation fervor' dissipates resources on pseudo-breakthroughs; routinized and refuge tracks must keep their ratio; Schumpeter's diagnosis is a problem of balance, not of stance
modern_applications_zh: 企业创新治理：年度绘制创新职能地图并追踪影响分布，把『例行化临界』列为董事会风险项
研发组织设计：按组合类型分流——渐进组合入流程轨道、偏离能力地图的组合入庇护轨道，配额与移植协议明文化
人才保留：为内部创意者保留创业式收益结构（跟投、分成），防止企业家职能持续外流给风险投资生态
投资评估：对研发密集企业不只看研发投入，审计其影响分布形态——影响收敛是例行化临界的领先指标
modern_applications_en: Corporate innovation governance: map the innovation function annually and track the impact distribution, listing 'routinization threshold' as a board-level risk item
R&D organization design: route by combination type—incremental combinations to the process track, capability-map-deviating ones to the refuge track, with codified quotas and transplantation protocols
Talent retention: preserve entrepreneurial return structures (co-investment, revenue share) for internal creatives, stemming the outflow of the entrepreneurial function to the venture ecosystem
Investment evaluation: for R&D-intensive firms, audit the shape of the impact distribution rather than the R&D spend alone—impact convergence is a leading indicator of the routinization threshold

modes.domain_zh: 用生产方式阶段论解释文明形态的更替，并把个体命运嵌入超个人尺度的大历史
modes.domain_en: Explaining the succession of civilizational forms through stages of production relations, and embedding individual destiny into the super-personal scale of grand history
modes.definition_zh: 熊彼特 1954 年《经济分析史》与《资本主义、社会主义与民主》共同展示了一种大尺度史学方法：把个体思想与制度放在生产方式与社会阶层的长时段演化中定位。他的『社会想象真空』命题是其中最锋利的工具——任何科学分析都内嵌于分析者所处时代的社会想象，纯粹的『眼睛看世界』不存在；经济学家看不见其时代未曾想象的东西。方法上有四步：其一，定位分析者的社会坐标——著作产生于哪一生产方式阶段、哪一阶层位置、哪一危机时刻；其二，提取文本的社会想象——识别作品对『什么是可能的、什么是自然的』的默认预设，这些预设比论证更能解释作品的边界；其三，用阶段论解释更替——把制度变迁（封建—资本主义—社会主义的熊彼特式序列）解释为生产方式与阶级结构变化的函数，而非观念史的内部演化；其四，双向校验——既用社会坐标解释思想局限，也承认思想的溢出（熊彼特本人对马克思：阶级分析法继承、预言方向相反）。这一方法的深意是：大历史叙事的价值不在预测而在定位——它给任何当代争论一个『我们处在哪个阶段』的坐标系，防止把阶段特征误认为永恒规律。
modes.definition_en: Schumpeter's History of Economic Analysis (1954) together with Capitalism, Socialism and Democracy exhibits a grand-scale historiographical method: situating individual ideas and institutions within the long-run evolution of modes of production and social strata. His sharpest tool in this is the 'pre-analytic vision' thesis: every scientific analysis is embedded in the social imagination of the analyst's era—pure 'eyes viewing the world' does not exist, and economists cannot see what their age has not imagined. The method has four steps. First, locate the analyst's social coordinates: which stage of production, which stratum, which crisis-moment produced the work. Second, extract the text's social imagination: identify its default premises about 'what is possible and what is natural'—these explain a work's boundaries better than its arguments do. Third, explain succession through stage theory: interpret institutional change (Schumpeter's sequence feudalism—capitalism—socialism) as a function of changing production relations and class structure, not as internal evolution of the history of ideas. Fourth, verify in both directions: use social coordinates to explain a thought's limits while acknowledging its overflow (Schumpeter on Marx: inheriting the class-analytic method, reversing the prophecy). The deeper point: the value of grand historical narrative lies not in prediction but in location—it gives any contemporary debate a coordinate system of 'which stage are we in,' preventing the stage's features from being mistaken for eternal laws.
modes.source_chapter: 《经济分析史》第一编 (History of Economic Analysis, 1954)；《资本主义、社会主义与民主》第一、三篇 (1942)
modes.key_quote_zh: 分析始于视野，视野先于分析——经济学家看不见他的时代不曾想象的东西。
modes.key_quote_en: Analysis begins in vision, and vision precedes analysis—an economist cannot see what his age has not imagined.
process_zh: 定位社会坐标：为研究对象（著作/制度/人物）标注生产方式阶段、阶层位置与所处危机时刻
提取默认预设：找出文本对『可能/自然/永恒』的未论证假设，评估这些预设如何划定其解释边界
用阶段函数解释更替：把制度变迁表述为生产方式与阶层结构变化的函数，检验观念史叙事是否遗漏物质条件
双向校验：用坐标解释思想的局限，同时识别思想对坐标的溢出——避免环境决定论的自我反驳
process_en: Locate social coordinates: for the object of study (work/institution/person) mark the stage of production, stratum position, and the crisis-moment at hand
Extract default premises: find the text's unargued assumptions about the possible/natural/eternal, and assess how they bound its explanatory reach

Explain succession as a stage function: express institutional change as a function of production relations and class structure, testing what the history-of-ideas narrative omits of material conditions
Verify in both directions: use coordinates to explain a thought's limits while recognizing its overflow beyond the coordinates—avoiding the self-refutation of environmental determinism
representative_cases_zh: 熊彼特论古典经济学：李嘉图的抽象方法被解释为『反映其时代对确定性的社会需求』——分析史与社会史的缝合示范
《经济分析史》对马克思的处理：承认其阶段论与社会想象命题的继承，同时用同一工具定位马克思的预言失败——方法的双向校验
凯恩斯主义的阶段定位：1936 年革命被解读为对垄断资本主义阶段的管理需求，而非纯理论进步——阶段论解释学派更替的范例
反例警示：阶段论极易滑向目的论——熊彼特本人反复拒绝『历史有必然终点』的读法，他的社会主义预言是趋势判断而非规律断言；使用阶段论须保留反事实空间（阶段可停滞、可逆转）
representative_cases_en: Schumpeter on classical economics: Ricardo's abstractive method explained as reflecting his era's social demand for certainty—a demonstration of stitching the history of analysis to social history

His treatment of Marx in the History of Economic Analysis: acknowledging the inheritance of stage theory and the social-imaginaries thesis while using the same tool to locate Marx's failed prophecy—the method's two-way verification

The stage-location of Keynesianism: the 1936 revolution read as a managerial demand of the monopoly-capitalist stage rather than pure theoretical progress—the exemplar of explaining schools by stage function

Cautionary case: stage theory slides easily into teleology—Schumpeter himself repeatedly refused the reading that 'history has a necessary endpoint'; his socialist prophecy was a trend judgment, not a law. Users of stage theory must preserve counterfactual space (stages can stagnate and reverse)
modern_applications_zh: 学术研究导论：任何领域综述先做『社会坐标』小节——该学科范式形成于什么时代问题，其默认预设是什么
当代议题定位：为 AI 监管、平台经济等新议题建立阶段坐标（对应工业史上哪一阶段的争论），借用历史阶段的原型案例
写作与授课：用『社会想象』教学解读经典文本——先恢复作者看不见的东西，再评估其论证
战略展望：把五年规划嵌入长波阶段坐标，区分『本阶段可行』与『跨阶段需要』的投资
modern_applications_en: Academic introductions: begin any literature review with a 'social coordinates' section—what era-problem shaped the discipline's paradigm, and what its default premises are

Locating contemporary issues: build stage coordinates for new topics (AI regulation, platform economy) by matching them to which industrial-era stage their debates resemble, borrowing prototype cases from that stage
Teaching and writing: use 'social imaginaries' to read canonical texts—first recover what the author could not see, then appraise the argument
Strategic outlook: embed five-year plans in long-wave stage coordinates, separating investments that are 'feasible in this stage' from those 'needed across stages'

modes.domain_zh: 以一人之力跨越经济学、社会学、政治学与史学，交付相互支撑的综合体系
modes.domain_en: Delivering a mutually supporting synthesis across economics, sociology, political science, and history by the strength of a single scholar
modes.definition_zh: 熊彼特的学术交付方式与哈耶克相反：哈耶克用六十年分层展开一个内核，熊彼特则同时在多个学科之间建立火力网——经济理论（《经济发展理论》《经济周期》）、社会学（《资本主义、社会主义与民主》）、思想史（《经济分析史》）、政治学（精英民主论）相互引用、互为证据，构成一个多面体。方法上有三步：其一，选定『多面体问题』——一个问题必须从多个学科面看才有答案（『资本主义将如何演变』在纯经济学内不可解），这是多学科投入的前提而非结果；其二，学科工具的分工表——为每个学科面明确其对该问题的贡献类型（经济学给机制、社会学给阶层、史学给定位、政治学给程序），防止学科间互相越界或重复；其三，交叉引用的交付结构——每部著作在脚注与结构上显式引用其余面，让读者能在任一入口进入体系并抵达其余部分。这一方法的深意是：综合不是把学科结论堆在一起，而是让同一问题在不同学科的透镜下得到互证的不同侧面；代价是任何单面都不完备（熊彼特的经济理论被主流批评为不严格），收益是只有体系能回答的问题终于有了答案。
modes.definition_en: Schumpeter's scholarly delivery inverted Hayek's: where Hayek unfolded one kernel in layers across sixty years, Schumpeter laid a cross-fire among several disciplines at once—economic theory (The Theory of Economic Development, Business Cycles), sociology (Capitalism, Socialism and Democracy), the history of thought (History of Economic Analysis), and political science (the elite theory of democracy)—each citing and evidencing the others, forming a polyhedron. The method has three steps. First, choose a 'polyhedral question': one whose answer exists only when seen from several disciplinary faces ('how will capitalism evolve' is unsolvable within economics alone)—this is the premise of multi-disciplinary investment, not its afterthought. Second, a division-of-labor table for disciplinary tools: state for each face what type of contribution it makes to the question (economics the mechanism, sociology the strata, history the location, political science the procedure), preventing boundary-crossing and duplication among disciplines. Third, a delivery structure of cross-citation: each work cites the other faces explicitly in footnotes and structure, so a reader entering anywhere in the system can reach the rest. The deeper point: synthesis is not piling disciplinary conclusions together but letting one question receive mutually corroborating aspects under different lenses; the cost is that no single facet is complete (Schumpeter's economics was faulted by the mainstream as unrigorous), the reward is that questions only a system can answer finally get answers.
modes.source_chapter: 《经济分析史》总导言 (History of Economic Analysis, 1954)；《资本主义、社会主义与民主》全书结构 (1942)；《十大经济学家》从马克思到凯恩斯的跨流派评传 (Ten Great Economists, 1951)
modes.key_quote_zh: 只从一个学科看问题的人，永远得不到需要多个学科才能看见的答案。
modes.key_quote_en: He who views a problem from a single discipline will never obtain the answer that requires many to see.
process_zh: 验证问题的多面性：检查核心问题是否在单一学科内不可解，若可解则退回单学科深耕而非铺面
编制学科分工表：为每个学科面写下其对核心问题的贡献类型与边界，明确『经济学负责机制、史学负责定位』式的分工
建立交叉引用结构：设计各交付物之间的显式引用与共同概念表，让体系从任一入口可达全体
接受单面不完备：为每个学科面设定其严格性标准，容忍单面被本学科批评，以体系整体性补偿
process_en: Verify the question's polyhedrality: check whether the core question is unsolvable within one discipline; if solvable, return to single-discipline depth rather than spreading faces
Compile the division-of-labor table: for each disciplinary face write its contribution type and boundary to the core question—'economics handles mechanism, history handles location'
Build a cross-citation structure: design explicit citations and a shared concept table across deliverables, so the system is reachable in whole from any entrance
Accept single-face incompleteness: set strictness standards per face, tolerating each face's criticism within its own discipline, compensating with the integrity of the whole system
representative_cases_zh: 《资本主义、社会主义与民主》的交付结构：全书三篇（马克思的方法/资本主义能否存续/社会主义可行吗/民主与社会主义）以社会学命题为主干，经济学论据为支撑，政治学定义为出口——一部书即一个多面体
《经济分析史》的综合雄心：从经院学者到凯恩斯，用『分析工具+政策处方』的统一框架覆盖两千年——把思想史本身做成体系化交付
熊彼特评传系列（从马克思到凯恩斯）：十篇评传共用一套『方法-成就-历史定位』结构，互为参照系——体系的组成部分先行交付的实例
反例警示：多学科火力网的代价是深度受疑——熊彼特的《经济周期》因统计检验不足被主流搁置，其社会学命题也因不可证伪被批评；选择此法者须预先声明各面的证据标准，防止体系以模糊换宏大
representative_cases_en: The delivery structure of Capitalism, Socialism and Democracy: three parts (Marx's method / can capitalism survive / can socialism work / democracy and socialism) with a sociological thesis as spine, economic arguments as support, and the political-science definition as exit—one book as one polyhedron

The synthesizing ambition of the History of Economic Analysis: from scholastics to Keynes under one framework of 'analytic tools plus policy prescriptions' across two millennia—making the history of thought itself a systematized delivery

The Schumpeter portrait series (Marx to Keynes): ten essays sharing one 'method-achievement-historical location' structure, each a reference frame for the others—an instance of a system's parts delivered first

Cautionary case: the price of a cross-disciplinary cross-fire is doubted depth—Business Cycles was set aside by the mainstream for insufficient statistical testing, and his sociological theses faulted as unfalsifiable; adopters must declare evidence standards per face in advance, lest the system trade precision for grandeur
modern_applications_zh: 研究者知识结构：为核心问题编制学科分工表，逐年补齐各面的工具（经济学面的数理、史学面的档案），按分工表而非兴趣漂移
内容创作者：把长线项目设计为多面体——单篇作品自足可读，又通过共同概念表与其余篇目互链，读者从任一篇进入可抵达全体
智库与咨询交付：综合性报告显式标注各章的学科工具与证据标准，让『单面严格性』与『体系完整性』同时可审计
学习策略：跨学科阅读时始终携带同一核心问题，为每本书写『它对本问题的透射面』笔记，避免博览而失焦
modern_applications_en: Researchers' knowledge structure: compile a division-of-labor table for the core question and fill in each face's tools year by year (mathematics for the economics face, archives for the history face), following the table rather than drifting by interest
Content creators: design long-term projects as polyhedra—each piece self-contained yet interlinked through a shared concept table, so readers entering anywhere can reach the whole
Think-tank and consulting deliverables: mark each chapter's disciplinary tools and evidence standards explicitly, making 'single-face rigor' and 'systemic integrity' auditable at once
Learning strategy: carry one core question across interdisciplinary reading, noting for each book 'the face it projects onto my question,' avoiding breadth without focus
